research.title: Data Preparation and Baselines for Support Request Classification
bullets: Cleaned support request text, standardized category labels using supplied guidelines, and removed duplicate messages before preparing training and evaluation splits.
Implemented TF-IDF and logistic regression baselines in scikit-learn, reporting macro-averaged metrics and inspecting confusion patterns between overlapping request categories.

work.title: Maintenance of Text Record Processing Utilities
bullets: Maintained Python utilities that validated incoming text records, normalized missing fields, and routed malformed entries to existing error handling routines.
Added regression tests for parsing edge cases and investigated processing failures using application logs and reproducible sample inputs.

projects.title: Bag-of-Words Baselines for Review Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented bag-of-words features and multinomial naive Bayes for review sentiment classification, following the prescribed training and evaluation procedure.
Compared unigram and bigram configurations on held-out reviews, examining misclassified examples containing negation, mixed sentiment, and uncommon vocabulary.
